# Movie.exe v${VERSION}

Movie.exe brings supported movie and series websites together in one place, available for Android and Chrome.

## Downloads

### Android

[Download ${APK_FILENAME}](${APK_URL})

### Android TV

[Download ${TV_APK_FILENAME}](${TV_APK_URL})

For ARM Android TV / Google TV (32-bit and 64-bit). Install on TV and open Movie.exe.
Use the TV remote alone, or pair an Android phone on the same Wi-Fi from the app.

### Chrome Extension

[Download ${ZIP_FILENAME}](${ZIP_URL})

## Installation

### Android

1. Download the APK.
2. Open the APK on your Android device.
3. Allow installation from this source if required.
4. Install and launch Movie.exe.

### Chrome Extension

1. Download and extract the ZIP.
2. Open `chrome://extensions`.
3. Enable Developer Mode.
4. Select **Load unpacked**.
5. Choose the extracted extension directory containing `manifest.json`.
